youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #10 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each shape slide to its real size 🌍 Did the UK vs Colorado get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow – number 11 drops tomorrow! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: total area in km² – Cambodia 181,035; Iceland 103,000; California 423,970; Norway 323,802; Chile 756,102; Ukraine 603,550; Colorado 269,601; UK 243,610 (countries: CIA World Factbook; US states: US Census Bureau).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
